subject: Animation
title: The Cel Animation Breakthrough
description: A quick win: understand The Cel Animation Breakthrough.

hook.text: In 1915, Earl Hurd patented cel animation — drawing characters on transparent sheets over a painted background.

buildup.text: Before cels, animators had to redraw every element of every frame, including backgrounds, from scratch.

discovery.text: Cels let artists reuse backgrounds and only redraw the moving parts, cutting production time enormously.

twist.text: The technique was so fundamental that every major studio used cels for nearly 80 years until computers replaced them.

climax.text: Cel animation made the entire golden age of animation economically possible.

punchline.text: A clear sheet of plastic made cartoons practical to produce.

quiz.question: Why was the invention of cel animation so important?
options: It added color to black-and-white cartoons
It let animators reuse backgrounds and only redraw moving parts, dramatically cutting production time
